subject: compute means along a specified axis of a multidimensional array

messages.author: 552cec1104f5ec25
messages.subject: compute means along a specified axis of a multidimensional array
parts:
Dear all,


Has anyone written a function that will compute means along a specified axis of a multidimensional array?


For example, this is possible in Python using numpy.mean(X, axis = 1)

http://docs.scipy.org/doc/numpy-1.10.1/reference/generated/numpy.mean.html#numpy.mean

I'm not sure if this is possible to specify in Stan because of the need to declare dimensions?



Many thanks,

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] compute means along a specified axis of a multidimensional array
parts:
There's not a built-in function to do it.

It's not possible to write one directly in Stan
for the reasons you point out --- there's no way
to specify a generic argument type.

It could be done in C++ and then enough signatures
defined in Stan that you could use it.

Otherwise, you just have to do it one-off for now.

- Bob
